description: Example content-industry extension, reusing research prerequisites.

nodes.title: Audience and channel brief
nodes.acceptance: Define the audience, intended action, channel constraints and tone from the actual business goal.

recipe.instructions: Describe the intended reader and the constraints of the delivery channel.

nodes.title: Sourced content draft
nodes.acceptance: Claims remain traceable and the draft suits the audience and channel.

recipe.instructions: Write a source-backed draft using the research findings and audience brief.

nodes.title: Editorial findings and handling
nodes.acceptance: Record concrete factual or editorial issues and how they were handled; do not infer approval from file existence.

recipe.instructions: Read the draft, verify consequential claims and resolve relevant review findings.

nodes.title: Final content
nodes.acceptance: The content meets goal.md and resolves or discloses review findings. External publication requires its own authorization.

recipe.instructions: Produce the final content and explain any remaining limits to the owner.
